title: Novel reactions of a profluorescent nitroxide probe with ozone showcase a cascade of solvent-dependent redox reactions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26395-26402
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03412D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zachary E. Brown, Carl P. Soltau, David L. Marshall, Steven E. Bottle, Branka Miljevic
This study explores the reactivity of the profluorescent nitroxide BPEAnit with ozone, showing a dose-dependent fluorescence response that yields multiple products influenced by solvent system and moisture content.
